title: Bias is a coin flip
prompt: It is 11:35 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: A busy morning. Look at what the larger timeframes are doing before you decide whether any of this is tradable.

whyNot.label: the last leg's direction
whyNot.why: The last 30 minutes is a lower high and a lower low on the 5m. That's three candles against a range that's been two-sided for hours and a Daily and 4H that hold no direction.

whyNot.label: picking the cleanest gap
whyNot.why: There are three clean 5m gaps and each was run through by the next move. A clean gap on a chart with no directional bias isn't a location, it's decoration.

reference.summary: A wide, two-sided morning: both sides taken, three gaps printed and each one traded through, on a Daily and 4H with no direction. There is no bias to hold and so nothing to align with. No trade.

bias.why: The Daily and 4H are ranging and this morning swung through both ends of it. Neutral is the read; either direction is a guess.

decision.why: Two-sided, no bias, every gap run through: no trade is the position. Waiting for a clean sweep and displacement from a clear location is defensible too.

draw.why: No consistent draw: price has been drawn both ways.

location.why: Price is back around the middle of a wide range.

next_objective.why: Price was drawn to the previous day high (20,984.75); it also traded to the unfilled gap at 20,977.5 to 20,987.5 on the way, which makes those defensible too. The question is where price was likely to be pulled, not what the next candle would do. A previous-day extreme is also a pool of buy-side or sell-side liquidity, so that answer is right on the side, if less exact.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG at the open
annotations.why: A clean gap that the next move ran straight through.
annotations.whyNot: A gap with no bias behind it just marks where price was.

annotations.label: 5m bearish FVG on the drop
annotations.why: Same: valid in form, and traded through.

annotations.label: 5m bullish FVG on the recovery
annotations.why: The third gap in three moves, each reversed.

lookFor: Neutral is a read. If you can't state the bias in a sentence, you can't trade with it.
Count how many times each gap held. Zero is the answer.
A busy chart isn't an active setup. Activity without direction is the environment to skip.
